This is a design mockup, not proof of implemented hero statistics. No invented powers, items, lore, levels or mechanics. Render only exact requested short labels. Preserve its grassy isometric world, camera and existing versatile blue-clothed adventurer. Completely replace every existing UI element. Beautiful crafted fantasy interface, NOT dark rectangular software panels and NOT a recolor of the old HUD.
Visual language: sculpted ivory-colored ceramic and luminous azure enamel, warm satin brass, flowing asymmetric curves, small honey-gold inset details, softly painted highlights. Shapes have graceful winglike sweeps and broad comfortable curves; restrained original engraved flourishes follow the edges. Material depth, overlapping pieces and appealing silhouette, an original illustrated fantasy artifact made by a skilled artisan. No giant frame, no angular black boxes, no straight white outlines.
Upper-left: four tiny separate rounded enamel settings with original resource icons and clearly readable counts — coin 5, log 0, stone 0, iron ingot 0. No long resource panel. Upper-right: small elegant curved ivory-and-azure time ornament displaying exactly “День 1” and “08:30”. No throne health or countdown.
Bottom-left: redesign the local minimap into an attractive softly rounded asymmetrical cartographic instrument, about 230 pixels wide at 1600-pixel screen width. Cream lip, azure inner frame and a small brass north detail. Inside show readable green terrain, partial gray invasion route, small hero marker, red entrance and blue objective markers. No entire continent or invented landmarks. Map surface larger than ornament.
Immediately to its right along the bottom: COMPACT flowing hero console, around 580 pixels wide and 95 pixels high, round portrait medallion of the actual blue-clothed, dark-haired, short-bearded hero C at left, separate small bow equipment inset at right, softly curved ivory central surface. Short readable labels: “I Вещи”, “B Стройка”, “P Исследования”, “O Герой”, “M Карта”. These open windows, not combat abilities. Do not add empty action slots or arbitrary filler controls.
No invented health, mana, XP, level, skill points or numerical character statistics. The hero is a versatile adventurer, not a fixed archer class. Readable deep blue lettering on pale areas, cream lettering on azure areas. Rich color and curved artistic silhouettes, most gameplay world unobstructed.
